name: unitb-iii-agentos
description: UnitB continuation of AgentOS on iii v0.22.1 primitives

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:examples && bun run typecheck:scripts && bun run typecheck:counts && bun run typecheck:tests
scripts.typecheck:scripts: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --strict --skipLibCheck scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck:counts: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --strict --skipLibCheck scripts/counts.ts
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --types bun,node --strict --skipLibCheck tests/*.test.ts tests/governance/*.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run test:governance && bun run counts:check && bun run build:website
